title: GDScript wrong line number reported if an error occurs in a loop conditional
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935] ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS (16 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory ### Issue description If I have a piece of code like this: ```gd extends Node2D var array = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] func _ready() -> void: var i = 0 while array[i] < 9: i += 1 ``` It will crash the game with an index out of bounds error when it tries to access array[7], which is expected. However, the error is always reported as having happened on the last line of the loop (in this case, on `i += 1`) instead of the conditional, where the error actually happened (`while array[i] < 9`). If you have a lot of code in this loop, this misalignment can trip you up. ### Steps to reproduce - Create a new Godot script. - Paste the following code: ```gd var array = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7] func _ready() -> void: var i = 0 while array[i] < 9: i += 1 ``` - Run the scene. Example from MRP (green square = error should have been reported here, red square = was reported here) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [while.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26569366/while.zip)
